title: Kissed Gooey French Vegetable Souffle
description: A satvik-friendly, one-pot French dish featuring black treacle and nuka-pickle, resulting in a fresh and gooey souffle.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large saucepan, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the grated carrots and zucchini, and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Stir in the black treacle, nuka-pickle, vegetable broth, tofu, salt, and pepper.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Transfer the mixture to a 1-quart souffle dish and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the souffle from the oven and let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Note: this recipe is for refrigerator pickling/preserving only — store in the refrigerator and consume within 1 week. Do not water-bath can without an acid (vinegar or lemon juice).
